explanation_full: The Decision Tree (DT) model's performance metrics are summarized in the scatter plot diagnostics. The model achieved an R2 score of 0.5605, indicating its ability to explain variance. Key error metrics include an RMSE of 0.1755 and an MAE of 0.1086. Furthermore, the correlation between predicted and actual values was 0.787161, suggesting a strong positive linear relationship. These metrics provide a clear, evidence-backed assessment of the DT model's predictive capability.
